subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 116 (ALT(FT)II-10). TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the subject; MT-INFO (multi-information), the partner in the title, is not drawn as a label, and the line from the subject's dot runs to VT-TD (vibrational tendencies). From the subject: BIA (bi-aitional), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and OBS (observation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From BIA: INFO-DY. From INFO-DY: P-FC (particular focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PROG-CONT: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From COS-P: STF (source transfer). From STF: CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis). From OBS: TRS (transition). From TRS: INTR (interpretation).
